summary: Mayville Engineering Company, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an underwritten offering of common stock. The company issued and sold 4,348,000 shares at $20.00 per share, with underwriters fully exercising a 30-day option for an additional 652,000 shares. Net proceeds of approximately $93.9 million will be used to reduce borrowings under its senior secured revolving credit facility, fund capital expenditures, and for working capital. The offering is registered under an effective S-3 shelf and expected to close on May 21, 2026. This capital raise reduces debt and provides growth capital, reflecting a capital returns type event.
